description: This file declares functions related to the Transport Layer Security (TLS) Connection Controller Object, including creation, remove, enroll, and initialize functions. It acts as an interface for TLS connection management in a system supporting TLS.

methods.name: TlsCreateConnController
methods.description: Creates a new TLS Connection Controller object with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: TlsCcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new TLS Connection Controller instance given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: TlsCcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the TLS Connection Controller object.

methods.name: TlsCcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects in the TLS Connection Controller instance.

methods.name: TlsCcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Connection Controller object.
